The '''W-O power coupling''' was a model of [[Power coupling/Legends|power coupling]] manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]]. The ''[[Starlight Intruder]]'' required W-O power couplings to handle the flow from the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] to the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] as standard [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] would be instantly blown out.<ref name="EGVV" />
